idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. The key is recorded when a request completes; a repeated request with the same key is not executed again.

Per the runbook, all production regions were rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 had never been healthy; its staging predecessor v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving a mixed fleet; a retry completed the rollout successfully. All three regions are now running v2.3.0. Recommend investigating the root cause of v2.3.1's failures before re-deploying.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

**Rollback completed:**
- Confirmed checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (18% error rate) across all regions after the latest deploy.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 had never been healthy in production (its staging predecessor v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy), so the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
- The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and left a mixed fleet (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west/eu-west still on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout.
- Verified: all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident opened:** SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and current healthy state. On-call has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since the rollback went to a previously-healthy production version (not a never-before-deployed one). Recommend root-causing v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt.
